what: Text and images start offset 16px to the upper left, blurred 10px and transparent, and are tied to scroll from when the top edge reaches 90% of the screen until the center reaches 75% (scrub 2 — follows 2 seconds late), sharpening into place. For cells in a horizontal row, the line can be raised 10% per cell so they come into focus in sequence

options.start: Start line — when the top edge reaches this % of the screen, default 90
options.end: End line — when the center reaches this % of the screen, default 75
options.step: Percent by which each item child raises its start and end line, default 0 (Farm site About three columns 10)

from.where: shared.js .fade-blur · index.js .js-top-intro-fade — original global.js fadeBlur: x · y -16px · blur 10px · opacity 0 → 0, top 90% → center 75%, scrub 2. The three About cells on wide screens go top (90 − i×10)% → center (75 − i×10)%
